fact: ANIP says the provisional electoral list is extracted directly from the Fichier National de l'État Civil, the same database used to issue the national identity card and the IFU tax identifier.

The article says the tax directorate and the emigration and immigration directorate have been trying interoperability with the RNPP for several years, and ANIP is extending it to about 100 other bodies to integrate the NPI.
Ecofin Agency reports the public-sector pension fund FNRB's proof-of-life service requires each retiree's NPI alongside the pension booklet number.
ANIP says electoral lists are generated from the RNPP.
